title: Limit preservation and pointwise versality over the integers
statement: Work over $S=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], with schemes and affine spectra [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a category fibred in groupoids on $\mathit{Sch}/S$ in the total-category convention of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Its fibre over $T$ consists of objects lying over $T$ and arrows over the identity; an arrow over $a:T\to U$ records a pullback identification. Call $\mathcal F$ limit preserving if for every small nonempty directed inverse system of affine schemes $T_i$ over $S$, with affine limit $T$, every object of $\mathcal F(T)$ descends to a stage, every isomorphism between stage objects descends to a later common stage, and equality of such isomorphisms over $T$ holds at a later common stage. For a scheme $U/S$, a point $u\in U$ is of finite type when $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(u)\to U$ is locally of finite type and quasi-compact [def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For $x\in\mathcal F(U)$ define versality at $u$ by the following Artinian lifting condition: for every surjection $g:A'\to A$ of Artinian local rings with nilpotent kernel, surjective residue maps $\rho:A\to\kappa(u)$ and $\rho':A'\to\kappa(u)$ with maximal-ideal kernels and $\rho g=\rho'$, every $a:\operatorname{Spec}A\to U$ reducing to the canonical point $u$, and every object $y'$ over $A'$ with a specified isomorphism $y'|_A\cong a^*x$, there is $a':\operatorname{Spec}A'\to U$ extending $a$ and an isomorphism $y'\cong(a')^*x$ restricting to the specified one. Artinian means descending chains of ideals stabilize, and local means having a unique maximal ideal. This is a definition; no existence, smoothness, or algebraicity assertion is made.
